milestones.title: Discovery & Architecture
completionCriteria: API and module contracts defined in api-contract.json
Strict file ownership boundaries mapped in ownership-map.json

milestones.title: Core Implementation
completionCriteria: PDF Reader extracts clean text from input PDF documents (Step 1)
Text Chunker splits extracted text with configurable chunk size and overlap (Step 2)
Vector Store embeds chunks using sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and indexes in ChromaDB (Step 3)
CLI and interactive interface collect user query (Step 4)
Retrieval embeds user query and fetches top-k relevant chunks (Step 5)

milestones.title: Integration, Testing & Security Audit
completionCriteria: All components integrate cleanly without errors
Unit and integration tests pass with high coverage
Security audit checks for injection, safe file handling, and dependency risks

milestones.title: Documentation & Release
completionCriteria: README.md with setup, CLI usage, and architecture overview
Windows launch scripts run_cli.bat and run_streamlit.bat
